detail.name: "Stray Birds"
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Remielle's Mindscape: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
detail.desc2:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Remielle.
"O bird that carries spring upon its wings, take my flowers, my wind, and my love. Carry them to the child of the sun, to my beloved partner-in-crime."
"May your footsteps never falter, may your dreams never lose their color, and may your path forever branch into countless bright and boundless tomorrows."
